title: DKA with K+ 3.1

beats.text: SIGMA: fluids + K+ first. Insulin when K+ is 3.5+.

caption:
DKA with K+ below 3.5: start fluids, replace potassium, and hold insulin until K+ is at least 3.5. Insulin pushes K+ into cells.

Save it for nights.

#EMREE #DKA #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #internlife

fact.claim: DKA: if K+ < 3.5 mmol/L, give fluids and potassium and delay insulin until K+ >= 3.5
fact.check: ADA/EASD/JBDS hyperglycemic crises consensus report, Diabetes Care 2024
fact.verified: ADA/EASD/JBDS/AACE/DTS hyperglycaemic crises consensus, Diabetes Care 2024 (insulin postponed until K+ > 3.5 mmol/L). Checked 18 Nov 2026.
